dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), running on Linux, developed by NACL. Typical GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL target for the ORCA project.
evidence: COPY count 35, CALL count 68 consistent with GnuCOBOL batch subprogram

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance billing (receipt/claim calculation) — specifically inpatient co-payment and public expense burden calculation (負担金額算定サブ for 入院用)
purpose.summary: ORCS02 is a subprogram in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that calculates patient co-payment amounts for inpatient claims under Japanese national health insurance rules. It handles numerous regional public expense subsidy schemes, elderly patient thresholds, income-based limits, and special calculation rules for various prefectures and insurance combinations. The program has an extensive revision history spanning 2002–2008 covering successive regulatory changes.

notable_features: Extensive Japanese-language comments (EUC-JP encoded, decoded as latin-1)
Very large single program (~20k lines, ~1MB) with 472 PERFORMs and 68 CALLs
35 COPY statements indicating heavy use of shared copybooks
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — pure batch subprogram
Detailed multi-year revision history in comments (01.00.01 through 04.03.01)
No COMP-3 usage despite financial calculations
Fixed-format source with occasional long lines (120 over 72 cols)
verdict.notes: File decoded with latin-1 but comments are actually EUC-JP (Japanese) encoded, causing mojibake in the displayed text. Content is clearly the JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system well-known in Japanese healthcare IT. Source truncated to first 16000 chars but structural indicators confirm a very large, mature production program.
